participant_1.name: Maya
participant_1.personality: Adventurous and determined, she enjoys life on the edge and loves the thrill of racing.
participant_1.background: I waitress during the day to supplement my income. I've light skin with big brown eyes. It's red with a blue stripe so it's shiny when I race. My main transportation is my motorbike. I wear a motorbike helmet to protect my head.

participant_2.name: George
participant_2.personality: Laid-back and experienced, he enjoys simple pleasures and has a great sense of humor.
participant_2.background: I go gambling in my spare time. I've been retired for years. I like to grill outdoors. I enjoy mowing my lawn on sunny days.
